idea-plugin.name: Free AI Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Free AI Commit Message for JetBrains IDEs

Generate clean, descriptive, conventional commit messages directly from your staged Git changes in JetBrains Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other IntelliJ Platform IDEs.

Features

  • Zero-Config Free Quick Start: Works out of the box with no API key or account creation required.
  • BYOK with Free Quotas: Connect directly with your own personal API keys for Gemini (1,500 req/day), Groq (14,400 req/day), OpenRouter, GitHub Models, DeepSeek, OpenAI, and Claude.
  • 100% Offline Local Models: Run completely offline with local Ollama (zero code leaves your machine).
  • Encrypted Key Storage: Keys are stored securely in JetBrains PasswordSafe (OS Keychain / Credential Manager / Secret Service). Zero plaintext tokens in config files.
  • Commit Toolbar Integration: One-click generation directly in the Git Commit Tool Window.
  • Context-Aware: Existing commit notes are passed as guidance context.
  • Customizable: Temperature, request timeout, diff budget, language, and Gitmoji toggle.

action.description: Generate a conventional commit message from staged changes
